Ready for a Change?

You’ve come to the right place. Our free in-home bathroom design consultations in Tampa, FL, high-end product selections, fast demos, and professional installation will take you from design to done in no time–and with no stress.

Full Bathroom Remodels

Our full bathroom remodel offers a seamless renovation process, replacing old fixtures with stylish, high-quality options. Enjoy a stress-free experience with our reliable team, fixed timelines, and no surprise costs, adding comfort, style, and value to your home.

Start Your Bathroom Remodel

Accessible Bathroom Remodels

Our accessible bathroom remodels provide stylish safety with ADA-compliant walk-in tubs and showers. Enjoy features like grab bars, slip-resistant flooring, and comfortable seats, all seamlessly integrated into a beautiful bathroom design for your comfort and peace of mind.

Enhance Bathroom Safety

Tub & Shower Updates

Our tub and shower remodels offer a quick, modern bathroom refresh. Our expert designers help you choose materials that complement your bathroom, and our efficient crews complete your new bathtub or shower in just a few days, revitalizing your space effortlessly.

FAQS

  • Yes. Our showroom is conveniently located in Tampa and has free on-site parking. You can explore wall surrounds, vanities, and fixtures to help visualize your remodel.

  • Allowing a Design Consultant to enter your home and view your bathroom can help us better understand your individual needs, style, and budget, and take necessary measurements to provide a more accurate price. You can also learn more about how we approach pricing and transparency.
  • Yes. We provide multiple financing plans designed to fit your budget. Learn more about our financing and seasonal offers.

  • Remodeling your bathroom increases the value of your home while adding comfort, safety, and convenience for many years to come. Investing in a home renovation project takes careful planning and consideration. Our proprietary bathroom remodeling process handles every aspect of your bathroom remodel, from design to done.
  • Absolutely. At Re-Bath®, we believe good design is something everyone should enjoy. Our design abilities range from traditional and transitional, to rustic and contemporary aesthetics. Meet Altamonte Springs’s best full-service bathroom remodeling company

If you’ve been dreaming of owning a bright, modern bathroom that will meet your needs, Re-Bath of Tampa is here to help. We’re a locally owned and operated bathroom remodeling company with a reputation for creating functional, inspiring bathrooms for our customers. We offer a wide selection of products and design options, including tubs, showers, sinks, and vanities. Our bathroom remodelers can also replace bathroom lighting and flooring.

Call to Book Your Free Design Consultation

We’ll guide you through the entire bathroom renovation process. During the design phase, we’ll discuss what you have in mind, offer suggestions, and put together a customized design. Your new bathroom can be planned and priced in the comfort of your own home. You’ll have the choice of various colors and patterns, as well as access to our exclusive and proprietary products.

A Local Team Serving Tampa Bay Homes

Homes in the Tampa Bay area often have bathrooms that were built decades ago and now show signs of aging, fiberglass tubs, outdated tile, or layouts that no longer work for modern living. We specialize in replacing these with sleek walk-in showers, walk-in tubs, and accessibility upgrades designed to last. Our team is proud to serve homeowners across Hillsborough, Pinellas, and Pasco Counties, helping families create safe, stylish bathrooms that add value to their homes.
